title: AU and NZ are different jurisdictions, and the code must know which it is on
origin: A New Zealand job judged by Australia's asbestos year (2004 rather than 2000), and separately a New Zealand job told to notify SafeWork NSW. Both shipped.
prompt: Write the notification text telling a contractor which regulator to notify about asbestos removal on this job. The inspection has propertyCountry, which is 'AU' or 'NZ'.

checks.why: The answer must branch on jurisdiction. A single regulator for every job is the defect.

The New Zealand regulator must actually appear. An earlier version of this check used a forward-only lookahead from 'SafeWork NSW', so a correct answer that named the NZ regulator FIRST was rejected -- blunter than the property it was checking.
